content.short: Rutgers Blockchain is a student-run organization that explores and promotes blockchain technology.
content.description: Rutgers Blockchain educates Rutgers University students about blockchain technology and its potential to enable the creation of next-generation applications. As a hub for education and community, the group promotes networking and collaboration by organizing a steady stream of events, workshops, and hackathons that bring together blockchain enthusiasts. Additionally, it helps Rutgers students identify and pursue career opportunities within the blockchain industry.
